description: PSUT students who close cases on Earth and now in orbit. We’re building health monitoring software to keep astronauts safe on long space missions. 🚀
summary: We developed a health monitoring solution that consists of two parts. Firstly, The VitaCuff, a device attached to the arm of an astronaut and measures vitals. Secondly, The Dashboard, a software dashboard that astronauts check-in to.
details: Our solution works on monitoring the vitals of astronauts constantly, and acting before any real damage occurs. The VitaCuff is attached to the arm of each astronaut all the time, it measures vitals, O2 levels, and radiation levels and uses Machine learning to detect any potential problems and reports back to the ship for action. The dashboard on the ship manages problems from VitaCuffs and acts with the approval of the team lead. After a decision is made, the Cuff applies the required medication directly into the bloodstream of the astronaut. In case no decision is made or the situation is too urgent, the Cuff makes a decision and dispenses the medication immediately. This solution eliminates the gap of communication, and reaction time in life threatining situations. This project should make space missions much less dangerous, and eliminate the need for a medical expert on board. We used a combination of python, javascript, node.js to implement this .
